verdict.rationale: Browser Use drives pages through natural-language goals handed to an agent, such as finding the top Hacker News story or filling in a job application. That implies element understanding without hardcoded selectors. However, the evidence documents only whole-task agent runs, not granular act/click/type primitives on described elements. Alternatively, the developer must drop to raw Playwright/Puppeteer over CDP, which is selector-based. Missing for 10: documented per-action primitives (act/click/type on described elements), evidence of DOM-understanding element resolution, evidence of resilience to selector or layout changes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
